STEP 5. Check for open circuit between engine coolant 
temperature sensor connector B-11 terminal 1 and ECM 
connector C-58 terminal 44 <M/T> or PCM connector C-55 
terminal 44 <A/T>.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Replace the ECM or PCM. Then go to Step 11.
NO : Repair it. Then go to Step 11.
STEP 6. Check the continuity at engine coolant 
temperature sensor harness side connector B-11.
(1) Disconnect the connector B-11 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Check for the continuity between terminal 2 and ground.
• Should be less than 2 ohm.
Q: Is the continuity normal?
YES : Go to Step 9.
NO : Go to Step 7.
